acceptance.decision: READY if all artifacts valid, every clean suite >=70%, and either clean>=85% with dev lower95>=-5pp, or clean>=80% with dev observed gain>=5pp and lower95>0. Otherwise BELOW_TARGET or INCONCLUSIVE as appropriate. No automatic extra rollouts/training.

analysis.clean: Report historical frozen paired cluster bootstrap and historical <=5pp gate separately; old outcomes/rules unchanged. New readiness rule uses absolute clean accuracy plus paired robustness.
analysis.dev: Paired B0-minus-OpenVLA differences; stratified paired bootstrap within suite x perturbation_category, preserving each stratum count; 20000 PCG64 draws, seed 20260922, 2.5/97.5 percentiles. Conditional development-panel uncertainty, not independent base-task or training-seed uncertainty.
analysis.validity: All 2000 clean and 210 dev pairs required, finite actions, recorder validation, matching task/state/seed/protocol and first-query inputs; failed/infrastructure cases follow frozen retry rules; no cherry-picking.

checkpoint_selection: Fixed epoch-2 endpoint. Epoch-1 development results are descriptive; no selection, early extension or outcome-dependent recipe change.
controls: Original B0 and 72k OFT B0 cached clean outcomes; Run B development-200 outcomes where available. Differences in training split and recipe prevent causal attribution.
historical_acceptance: The historical Week4 clean-comparison FAIL and <=5pp rule remain unchanged; READY means pragmatic v2 baseline readiness under this newly declared rule.

holdouts.test: v2 supervised test remains locked and unused in this experiment.
holdouts.validation: All 230250 v2 validation chunks after each epoch; motion/gripper/all L1, decoded MAE and gripper accuracy; micro and task/group/variant/chunk hierarchy.

rollouts.reference_clean: reuse pinned audited installed OpenVLA outcomes with initial-input parity
rollouts.reference_dev: new installed OpenVLA run on the identical dev-210 manifest and seeds; verify first-query input parity before paired claims
